description: This file defines the LoginModel class for the Identity area in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application. It handles user login requests, manages external login schemes, and transfers anonymous baskets upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginModel
classes.description: A Razor Page model for handling user login, including external authentication schemes and basket transfer.

classes.name: LoginModel.InputModel
classes.description: A nested class representing the login form data, including email, password, and remember me options.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Handles the GET request for the login page; clears external login cookies and retrieves available external schemes.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles the POST request for user login; authenticates user and manages basket transfer upon success.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketToUserAsync
methods.description: Transfers an anonymous shopping basket to the logged-in user after successful login.
